+def bf16_arguments(experts, routed: nn.Module) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """The per-layer arguments of the BF16 experts op, read from the stock
+    TrtLlmBf16ExpertsMonolithic and its RoutedExperts as the stock layer passes them
+    (RoutedExperts.forward_monolithic -> apply_monolithic -> apply, with the
+    post-expert-norm hook attached, so do_finalize=False)."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.experts.trtllm_bf16_moe import (
+        view_as_block_major_k,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.utils import fi_moe_largest_bucket
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.flashinfer_utils import (
+        activation_to_flashinfer_int,
+    )
+
+    if experts.post_gemm2_hook is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "The stock BF16 experts finalize inside the op, so the experts op "
+            "would differ from the stock one."
+        )
+    if routed.routing_sink is not None:
+        raise RuntimeError("Routed experts capture is not supported.")
+    if experts.topk != TOP_K:
+        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected stock BF16 experts configuration.")
+    return dict(
+        routing_bias=routed.e_score_correction_bias,
+        gemm1_weights=view_as_block_major_k(routed.w13_weight),
+        gemm2_weights=view_as_block_major_k(routed.w2_weight),
+        num_experts=routed.global_num_experts,
+        top_k=experts.topk,
+        n_group=routed.num_expert_group,
+        topk_group=routed.topk_group,
+        intermediate_size=experts.intermediate_size_per_partition,
+        local_expert_offset=experts.ep_rank * experts.local_num_experts,
+        local_num_experts=experts.local_num_experts,
+        routed_scaling_factor=routed.routed_scaling_factor,
+        routing_method_type=experts.routing_method_type,
+        activation_type=activation_to_flashinfer_int(routed.activation),
+        tune_max_num_tokens=fi_moe_largest_bucket(experts.moe_config),
+        routing_replay_out=None,
+        do_finalize=False,
+    )
+
+
+def stock_experts(moe: nn.Module) -> tuple[Any, nn.Module]:
+    """The stock experts kernel and RoutedExperts of a MuseSpark1xMoE."""
+    routed = moe.experts.routed_experts
+    kernel = getattr(routed.quant_method, "moe_kernel", None)
+    if kernel is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("The stock MoE layer has no experts kernel.")
+    return kernel.fused_experts, routed
+
+
+def stock_all_reduce(communicator) -> tuple[Any, str | None]:
+    """The TP communicator's FlashInfer all-reduce wrapper, checked to take the
+    decode's [PREPARED_MAX, HIDDEN] bf16 rows (so the stock layers' all-reduce
+    is this one), and the backend its workspace resolved to
+    (VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND; auto: MNNVL, on one node TRT-LLM where
+    MNNVL has no multicast). Creates the workspace on first use, collectively
+    over the TP group, as the stock path does; vLLM keeps one per process, so
+    every caller reads the same backend."""
+    from vllm.distributed.device_communicators.flashinfer_all_reduce import (
+        get_fi_ar_workspace,
+    )
+
+    wrapper = getattr(communicator, "fi_ar_comm", None)
+    if wrapper is None or wrapper.disabled:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "The specialized decode's all-reduce needs vLLM's FlashInfer all-reduce."
+        )
+    probe = torch.empty(
+        (PREPARED_MAX, HIDDEN), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=communicator.device
+    )
+    if not wrapper.should_use_fi_ar(probe):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"vLLM's FlashInfer all-reduce does not take [{PREPARED_MAX}, {HIDDEN}] "
+            "bf16 here."
+        )
+    workspace = get_fi_ar_workspace(
+        world_size=wrapper.world_size,
+        rank=wrapper.rank,
+        max_token_num=wrapper.max_num_tokens,
+        hidden_dim=HIDDEN,
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        group=wrapper.group,
+    )
+    return wrapper, getattr(workspace, "backend", None)
+
+
+def stock_sum_order(communicator) -> str:
+    """The sum order of the stock TP all-reduce (``stock_all_reduce``'s backend,
+    ``BACKEND_SUM_ORDERS``), the one the fused all-reduces over the TP group
+    take. Raises for a backend whose order they do not reproduce. Collective
+    over the TP group on the process's first call."""
+    _, backend = stock_all_reduce(communicator)
+    order = BACKEND_SUM_ORDERS.get(backend) if backend is not None else None
+    if order is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"The fused all-reduce has no sum order for vLLM's {backend!r} "
+            "FlashInfer all-reduce."
+        )
+    return order
+
+
+def bind_all_reduce(communicator):
+    """The TP communicator's FlashInfer all-reduce wrapper, checked to be the MNNVL
+    all-reduce the stock layers take for [PREPARED_MAX, HIDDEN] bf16
+    (``stock_all_reduce``)."""
+    backend = envs.VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND
+    if backend not in ALL_REDUCE_BACKENDS:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"The TP8/16 all-reduce needs the MNNVL backend, got {backend!r}."
+        )
+    wrapper, resolved = stock_all_reduce(communicator)
+    if resolved != "mnnvl":
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "vLLM's FlashInfer all-reduce did not resolve to the MNNVL backend."
+        )
+    return wrapper
+
+
+def tp_coordinator(group):
+    """The TP GroupCoordinator, given it or its device group."""
+    tp = get_tp_group()
+    if group is not tp and group is not tp.device_group:
+        raise ValueError("FlashInferOps.build takes the TP group.")
+    return tp
+
+
+def _finite(rows: torch.Tensor) -> str:
+    """How finite ``rows`` are, and their largest finite magnitude."""
+    finite = torch.isfinite(rows)
+    largest = rows.float().abs().masked_fill(~finite, 0).max() if rows.numel() else 0
+    return f"{int(finite.sum())}/{rows.numel()} finite (max |x| {float(largest):.3g})"
+
+
+# The expert-TP build probe: rel L2 of a layer's TP route rows, summed across
+# ranks, against its EP rows (expected ~3e-3: one more BF16 rounding per rank;
+# a wrong slice or scale gives O(1)).
+EXPERT_TP_PROBE_MAX = 1e-2
+
+
+class FlashInferOps:
+    """``RoutedExpertsOps``: the routed experts of every MoE layer and the TP16
+    all-reduce.
+
+    build() binds every per-layer argument and checks every requirement once, then
+    runs each op once at b = 8 (rank-symmetric; the all-reduce workspace is created
+    lazily otherwise). The calls are graph-capturable and read no per-step state.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.nvfp4: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        self.bf16: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        self.all_reduce_wrapper = None
+        # The NVFP4 calls below the public op (prepare_from_metadata).
+        self.nvfp4_calls: dict[int, Nvfp4Call] = {}
+        self.prepared: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()
+        self.body_workspace: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] = ()
+        # Per token count, the (tile, config) keys of the tactics the NVFP4
+        # op takes (prepare_from_metadata).
+        self.valid_tactics: dict[int, set[tuple[int, int]]] = {}
+        # Expert TP: the NVFP4 layers on TP experts (their arguments in
+        # nvfp4), the TP experts' bytes and each layer's build probe.
+        self.tp_experts: set[int] = set()
+        self.tp_bytes = 0
+        self.probe_rel_l2: dict[int, float] = {}
+        # Their tactic (pin_tp_tactic) and the preferences it came from; None:
+        # the op's untuned default.
+        self.tp_preferred: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...] = ()
+        self.tp_tactic: tuple[int, int] | None = None
+
+    def build(
+        self, group, layers: tuple[nn.Module, ...], use_expert_tp: bool = False
+    ) -> None:
+        """``layers``: the stock decoder layers (layer_idx, feed_forward).
+
+        With ``use_expert_tp`` (collective over the TP group, which must equal the
+        stock layers' EP group), every NVFP4 layer runs on TP experts resharded
+        from the stock ones (finalized by the package's TP tail); BF16 layers
+        stay EP (stock weights, the EP tail)."""
+        from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.experts.trtllm_bf16_moe import (
+            TrtLlmBf16ExpertsMonolithic,
+        )
+        from vllm.models.muse_spark.nvidia.muse_moe_runner import (
+            MuseSparkTrtLlmNvFp4Experts,
+        )
+
+        tp = tp_coordinator(group)
+        for layer in layers:
+            experts, routed = stock_experts(layer.feed_forward)
+            if isinstance(experts, MuseSparkTrtLlmNvFp4Experts):
+                self.nvfp4[layer.layer_idx] = nvfp4_arguments(experts, routed)
+            elif isinstance(experts, TrtLlmBf16ExpertsMonolithic):
+                self.bf16[layer.layer_idx] = bf16_arguments(experts, routed)
+            else:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"Layer {layer.layer_idx} runs {type(experts).__name__}, not "
+                    "the TRT-LLM-gen experts the specialized decode calls."
+                )
+        seconds = 0.0
+        if use_expert_tp:
+            # Before the calls below the op are prepared: they bind the
+            # arguments, one shape for every NVFP4 layer.
+            start = time.perf_counter()
+            self.shard_experts(tp, layers)
+            seconds = time.perf_counter() - start
+        self.prepare_from_metadata()
+        if use_expert_tp:
+            # After the calls are prepared: the tactic needs a prepared body.
+            self.pin_tp_tactic(tp)
+        self.warm_up()
+        if use_expert_tp:
+            self.log_expert_tp(tp.world_size, seconds)
+        if tp.world_size in MNNVL_TPS:
+            # At TP8 only the check: the attention boundary sums in this
+            # all-reduce's order.
+            communicator = tp.device_communicator
+            wrapper = bind_all_reduce(communicator)
+            if tp.world_size in ALL_REDUCE_TPS:
+                self.all_reduce_wrapper = wrapper
+                x = torch.zeros(
+                    (BATCHES[0], HIDDEN),
+                    dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                    device=communicator.device,
+                )
+                self.all_reduce(x)
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------- expert TP
+    def shard_experts(self, tp, layers: tuple[nn.Module, ...]) -> None:
+        """Replaces every NVFP4 layer's arguments by its TP experts': reshard
+        (collective) and a probe against the stock EP op. Collective over
+        ``tp``: the placement check is agreed across the ranks before any
+        rank raises, so none is left waiting in the reshard."""
+        if not self.nvfp4:
+            raise RuntimeError("Expert TP needs NVFP4 layers.")
+        group = tp.device_group
+        nvfp4_layers = [layer for layer in layers if layer.layer_idx in self.nvfp4]
+        ep_ranks = {
+            stock_experts(layer.feed_forward)[0].ep_rank for layer in nvfp4_layers
+        }
+        wrong = sorted(ep_ranks - {tp.rank_in_group})
+        reason = (
+            f"got EP rank {wrong[0]} on TP rank {tp.rank_in_group}" if wrong else None
+        )
+        reason = expert_tp.agree(tp.cpu_group, reason, "cpu")
+        if reason is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"Expert TP needs the EP rank to be the TP rank: {reason}."
+            )
+        for layer in nvfp4_layers:
+            index = layer.layer_idx
+            experts, routed = stock_experts(layer.feed_forward)
+            ep_args = self.nvfp4[index]
+            shards = expert_tp.reshard_nvfp4(
+                stock_shards(ep_args, experts), group, routed.global_num_experts
+            )
+            tp_args = tp_arguments(ep_args, shards)
+            self.probe_rel_l2[index] = self.probe(
+                index, tp_args, group, experts.quant_config.a1_gscale
+            )
+            self.nvfp4[index] = tp_args
+            self.tp_experts.add(index)
+            self.tp_bytes += sum(
+                t.numel() * t.element_size()
+                for t in shards
+                if isinstance(t, torch.Tensor)
+            )
+
+    def log_expert_tp(self, tp: int, seconds: float) -> None:
+        """Logs the expert-TP build: what was resharded, its memory, the build
+        probes and the tactic the decode batch takes (None: no body prepared
+        for it, so the public op runs)."""
+        args = self.nvfp4[min(self.tp_experts)]
+        num_local = args["local_num_experts"]
+        tactic = tactic_key(self.tp_tactic or -1, BATCHES[0], num_local)
+        probes = self.probe_rel_l2.values()
+        pinned = (
+            "the op's default: no preferred tactic valid on every rank"
+            if self.tp_tactic is None
+            else f"pinned: preference {self.tp_preferred.index(self.tp_tactic) + 1}"
+            f" of {len(self.tp_preferred)}, on every rank"
+        )
+        logger.info(
+            "Muse Spark expert TP built: TP%d, %d NVFP4 layers (%d BF16 layers "
+            "EP), %d experts at intermediate %d per rank, +%.2f GiB per rank, "
+            "probe rel L2 %.3g..%.3g, tactic %s at %d tokens (%s), %.1f s",
+            tp,
+            len(self.tp_experts),
+            len(self.bf16),
+            num_local,
+            args["intermediate_size"],
+            self.tp_bytes / 2**30,
+            min(probes),
+            max(probes),
+            tactic if tactic in self.prepared else None,
+            BATCHES[0],
+            pinned,
+            seconds,
+        )
+
+    def probe_inputs(
+        self, device: torch.device, global_scale: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[ExpertsInput, RoutedTopk]:
+        """The build probe's input at the decode batch, the same on every rank
+        (seeded): unit-RMS rows quantized with ``global_scale`` (the layer's
+        NVFP4 input global scale), so they stay in the range the layer's scales
+        were calibrated for, and routes spread over all experts, so every EP
+        rank serves some."""
+        from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+
+        b = BATCHES[0]
+        g = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(20261023)
+        x = torch.randn((b, POOLED), generator=g, device=device)
+        a, a_sf = ops.scaled_fp4_quant(
+            x.to(torch.bfloat16), global_scale, is_sf_swizzled_layout=False
+        )
+        inputs = ExpertsInput(a, a_sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).reshape(b, -1))
+        routes = torch.arange(b * TOP_K, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        stride = NUM_EXPERTS // (b * TOP_K)
+        topk = RoutedTopk(
+            (routes * stride + routes // TOP_K % stride).view(b, TOP_K),
+            torch.full((b, TOP_K), 1.0 / TOP_K, device=device),
+        )
+        return inputs, topk
+
+    def probe(
+        self,
+        layer: int,
+        tp_args: dict[str, Any],
+        group,
+        global_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> float:
+        """Rel L2 of the layer's TP route rows, summed across ranks, against its
+        stock EP rows on the same stock-quantized input (collective); raises
+        above EXPERT_TP_PROBE_MAX on every rank."""
+        inputs, topk = self.probe_inputs(tp_args["gemm1_weights"].device, global_scale)
+        outputs = []
+        for args in (self.nvfp4[layer], tp_args):
+            out = self.public_routed_experts(args, inputs, topk)
+            outputs.append((out.gemm2_permuted, out.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx))
+        rel = expert_tp.probe_rel_l2(outputs[0], outputs[1], group)
+        if not rel < EXPERT_TP_PROBE_MAX:
+            ep_rows, ep_local = expert_tp.route_rows(*outputs[0])
+            tp_rows, _ = expert_tp.route_rows(*outputs[1])
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"Layer {layer}: the TP experts differ from the stock EP experts "
+                f"by rel L2 {rel:.3g} (at most {EXPERT_TP_PROBE_MAX}); on this "
+                f"rank the EP rows of its {int(ep_local.sum())} routes are "
+                f"{_finite(ep_rows[ep_local])}, its TP partial rows "
+                f"{_finite(tp_rows)}."
+            )
+        logger.debug("Muse Spark expert TP: layer %d probe rel L2 %.3g", layer, rel)
+        return rel
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def expert_tp_tactics() -> tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]:
+        """The preferred expert-TP tactics measured on the installed FlashInfer's
+        batched-GEMM cubin package; none for any other package."""

+"""The Muse Spark DSpark draft's fused Markov sampling loop.
+
+``DSparkSpeculator`` samples the draft tokens left to right, adding each
+step's Markov bias to the base draft logits. ``MarkovSampler`` runs that loop
+with each step's tail as one CuTe DSL kernel (``cutedsl/draft/markov.py``),
+bitwise equal to the speculator's eager loop on rows without NaN.
+
+Each row samples the lowest vocab id whose noised logit is NaN, else the
+lowest id of the maximum (the ``torch.argmax`` order), at every block size and
+vocab shard. On a row with a NaN the eager loop's pick depends on its block
+layout, so the two can differ there.
+
+With a vocab-parallel Markov w2 each rank samples its own vocab range
+(``VocabParallelMarkovHead``) and the ranks exchange one packet per request
+and step. The draft model builds it on the first call of its
+``sample_sequential`` hook, from the speculator's sampling state.
+"""
+

+import functools
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, NamedTuple
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.distributed import (
+    get_tensor_model_parallel_rank,
+    get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size,
+)
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization import QuantizationConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.utils import dispatch_unquantized_gemm
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (
+    ParallelLMHead,
+    UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.models.qwen3_dspark import DSparkMarkovHead
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import maybe_prefix
+from vllm.models.common.ops.sequence_parallel import sp_all_gather
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv, round_up
+
+from ..cutedsl.common.policy import batch_table
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# gumbel_sample's BLOCK_SIZE.
+MARKOV_BLOCK = 1024
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class FusedMarkovParams:
+    """Static inputs of the fused loop, fixed once the draft model loads."""
+
+    w1: torch.Tensor
+    """Markov w1 table ``[V, R]`` (bf16, R a power of two)."""
+    vocab_size: int
+    output_multiplier: float
+    """Rounded to fp32, as torch multiplies an fp32 tensor by it."""

+    inv_soft_cap: float

+    """This rank's contiguous vocab range of the draft lm_head and Markov w2."""

+# so that its blocks start while the w2 GEMV runs. Measured on GB300, the
+# overlap pays at one and two rows and costs from three rows on.
+STEP_PDL_MAX_ROWS = 2

+# markov_step's vocab entries per CTA, by row count; other row counts take
+# MARKOV_BLOCK. Smaller blocks spread a step over more SMs; on GB300 at the

+# samples the same id at any block size: each argmax takes the first NaN, else
+# the first maximum.
+STEP_BLOCKS = batch_table("0-16:512")

+    """markov_step's block for a call over ``num_rows`` rows."""
+    return STEP_BLOCKS.get(num_rows, MARKOV_BLOCK)

+class VocabParallelMarkovHead(DSparkMarkovHead):
+    """``DSparkMarkovHead`` with ``markov_w2`` sharded like the draft lm_head:
+    each rank computes its vocab range of the transition bias
+    (``local_bias``)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        draft_vocab_size: int,
+        markov_rank: int,
+        prefix: str,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        # DSparkMarkovHead.__init__ would first allocate the replicated w2:
+        # the same modules are built here, with the w2 sharded from the start.
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        self.markov_w1 = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, markov_rank)
+        # The same parameter name and loader as the replicated w2, sharded.
+        self.markov_w2 = ParallelLMHead(
+            draft_vocab_size,
+            markov_rank,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "markov_w2"),
+        )
+        self.markov_w2._retain_weight_for_gather = False
+        self.markov_w2.is_w4a16_nvfp4 = False
+        # Rank-local w2 rows padded to a 16-byte row count, set by
+        # align_vocab_shard() once the weights are loaded.
+        self._local_w2: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+    def align_vocab_shard(self) -> None:
+        """Back the rank's unquantized ``markov_w2`` rows with storage padded
+        by zero rows to a 16-byte multiple, read by :meth:`local_bias`.
+
+        cuBLAS picks its GEMV kernel by shape; the padded shard keeps the
+        replicated head's sums, an unaligned one does not.
+        """
+        if not isinstance(self.markov_w2.quant_method, UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod):
+            return
+        weight = self.markov_w2.weight
+        if (
+            self._local_w2 is not None
+            and weight.data_ptr() == self._local_w2.data_ptr()
+        ):
+            # A reload wrote into the padded storage, which captured CUDA
+            # graphs keep reading.
+            return
+        rows = weight.shape[0]
+        per_16_bytes = 16 // weight.element_size()
+        padded = weight.new_zeros((round_up(rows, per_16_bytes), weight.shape[1]))
+        padded[:rows].copy_(weight)
+        weight.data = padded[:rows]
+        self._local_w2 = padded
+
+    def local_bias(self, markov_embed: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """This rank's vocab shard of the transition bias ([B, r] -> [B, V/tp]).
+
+        The result is a view with the row stride of the padded storage.
+        """
+        assert self._local_w2 is not None
+        rows = self.markov_w2.weight.shape[0]
+        return dispatch_unquantized_gemm()(
+            self.markov_w2, markov_embed, self._local_w2
+        )[:, :rows]
+
+
+def markov_vocab_shard(model: Any) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
+    """This rank's ``[start, end)`` draft-vocab range of a vocab-parallel
+    Markov w2, or None when the w2 is replicated.
+
+    Called once the weights are loaded; prepares the padded w2 storage

+    computations would not return this range's columns of
+    ``model.compute_draft_logits`` and ``model.markov_bias`` on the default
+    GEMM (under ``--linear-backend`` they match to rounding only).
+    """
+    head = model.model.markov_head
+    w2 = head.markov_w2

+        return None

+            "The vocab-parallel Markov head needs an unquantized bf16 Markov w2"
+        )

+    w2_range = w2.shard_indices

+        # The local bias runs the default GEMM that markov_bias runs through
+        # the logits processor and UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod.apply unless
+        # --linear-backend selects another one.
+        model.logits_processor.scale != 1.0
+        or model.logits_processor.soft_cap is not None

+        or lm_head.tp_size != w2.tp_size
+        or w2.num_embeddings_padded != vocab_size
+        or lm_head.num_embeddings_padded != vocab_size
+        or w2_range.added_vocab_end_index != w2_range.added_vocab_start_index
+        or lm_range.added_vocab_end_index != lm_range.added_vocab_start_index
+        or (w2_range.org_vocab_start_index, w2_range.org_vocab_end_index)
+        != (lm_range.org_vocab_start_index, lm_range.org_vocab_end_index)
+    ):

+            "The vocab-parallel Markov head needs a logits processor without "
+            "scale or soft cap, no VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT, and a draft lm_head "
+            "and Markov w2 split into the same unpadded vocab ranges"

+def compute_local_draft_logits(model: Any, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """This rank's vocab shard of ``model.compute_draft_logits``, ungathered."""
+    return model.logits_processor(
+        model.lm_head, hidden_states.to(model.lm_head.weight.dtype), skip_gather=True

+def vocab_shard(params: FusedMarkovParams, start: int, end: int) -> MarkovVocabShard:
+    """The sharded loop's view of this rank's draft-vocab range.

+    must hold the k-th equal slice of the draft vocabulary. The w2 is
+    never replicated in this mode, so a draft the loop does not take fails
+    at its first draft step instead of running the eager loop on gathered
+    shards.
+    """
+    tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+    size = end - start
+    if tp_size & (tp_size - 1):
+        reason = f"a power-of-two TP size, not {tp_size}"
+    elif size * tp_size != params.vocab_size:
+        reason = (
+            f"a draft vocabulary ({params.vocab_size}) that TP {tp_size} "
+            "divides without padding"
+        )
+    elif start != size * get_tensor_model_parallel_rank():
+        reason = "TP rank k to hold the k-th slice of the draft vocabulary"
+    else:
+        return MarkovVocabShard(tp_size=tp_size, size=size, offset=start)

+        ...
+
+    def nvfp4_plan(self, layer: int, inputs: ExpertsInput, topk: RoutedTopk) -> Any:
+        """Host only: how the NVFP4 call for these inputs runs from routing
+        metadata (its ``metadata`` is what the routing writes), or None."""
+        ...
+
+    def routed_experts(
+        self, layer: int, inputs: ExpertsInput, topk: RoutedTopk, plan: Any = None
+    ) -> UnfinalizedExperts: ...
+
+    def routed_experts_bf16(
+        self, layer: int, x: ExpertsInputBf16, router_logits: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> UnfinalizedExperts:
+        """The BF16 op routes inside, from the fp32 [b, NUM_EXPERTS] router
+        logits, as the stock BF16 layers do."""
+        ...
+
+    def all_reduce(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: ...
+
+
+def _scratch(ctx: BuildContext, name: str, shape, dtype) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """An executor buffer shared by every layer (allocated once, at build)."""
+    buffer = ctx.buffers.get(name)
+    if buffer is None:
+        buffer = torch.empty(shape, dtype=dtype, device=ctx.device)
+        ctx.buffers[name] = buffer
+    assert buffer.shape == shape and buffer.dtype == dtype, name
+    return buffer
+
+
+class QkvAttention:
+    """The attention: the QKV front (the CuTe kernel of
+    cutedsl/attention/qkv_front.py: QKV + o-gate GEMM, QK norm, RoPE and the
+    K/V insert), attn2 (the CuTe kernel of cutedsl/attention/attn2.py: paged
+    attention of the 8-token verify step with the o-norm and sigmoid gate) and
+    the o_proj partial (``OProjection``: cuBLAS; at TP8 the package GEMM, which
+    also publishes the partial into the attention boundary's mailbox)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        attn: nn.Module,
+        oproj: Any,
+        qkv: torch.Tensor,
+        out: torch.Tensor,
+        partial: torch.Tensor,
+        max_context: int,
+        window: int,
+        num_splits: int,
+        workspace: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ):
+        self.attn = attn
+        self.layer_name = attn.attn.layer_name
+        self.max_context, self.window = max_context, window
+        self.num_splits, self.workspace = num_splits, workspace
+        self.weight = attn.qkv_proj.weight
+        self.cos_sin_cache = attn.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache if attn.use_rope else None
+        self.eps = attn.rms_norm_eps
+        self.num_kv_heads = attn.num_kv_heads
+        self.oproj, self.qkv, self.out, self.partial = oproj, qkv, out, partial
+
+    @classmethod
+    def unsupported(cls, vllm_config) -> str | None:
+        from . import cute_ops
+
+        if not cute_ops.qkv_front_available():
+            return cute_ops.unavailable(cute_ops.QKV_FRONT_KERNEL)
+        if not cute_ops.attn2_available():
+            return cute_ops.unavailable(cute_ops.ATTN2_KERNEL)
+        return None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def build(cls, ctx: BuildContext, layer: nn.Module | None) -> "QkvAttention":
+        from ..cutedsl.oproj.batt import OProjection
+        from . import cute_ops
+
+        assert layer is not None
+        attn = layer.self_attn
+        reason = cute_ops.unsupported_attn2(attn) or cute_ops.unsupported_projection(
+            attn
+        )
+        if reason is None and (
+            attn.use_attn_temperature_tuning or not attn.fused_qk_norm_rope_kv_insert
+        ):
+            reason = "attention without the stock fused QK-norm/RoPE/KV insert"
+        if reason is not None:
+            raise ValueError(f"layer {layer.layer_idx}: {reason}")
+        n = attn.qkv_proj.weight.shape[0]
+        cute_ops.prepare_qkv_front(n, BATCHES)
+        qkv = _scratch(ctx, "qkv", (PREPARED_MAX, n), torch.bfloat16)
+        out = _scratch(
+            ctx,
+            "attention",
+            (PREPARED_MAX, attn.num_heads * attn.head_dim),
+            torch.bfloat16,
+        )
+        partial = _scratch(ctx, "partial", (PREPARED_MAX, HIDDEN), torch.bfloat16)
+        # attn2 splits a long context over a fixed number of clusters (the
+        # deployment's, so the captured launch fits every step); the split
+        # merge's workspace is shared by the layers, which run in order, sized
+        # for the full-attention layers' splits (a window only lowers them)
+        # and zeroed once (every launch leaves its counters zero).
+        window = cute_ops.attn2_window(attn.attn.sliding_window, ctx.max_context)
+        num_splits = cute_ops.attn2_splits(ctx.max_context, window, attn.num_kv_heads)
+        cute_ops.prepare_attn2(ctx.max_context, window, attn.num_kv_heads, num_splits)
+        workspace = None
+        if cute_ops.attn2_split_kernel(ctx.max_context, window):
+            size = cute_ops.attn2_workspace_bytes(
+                PREPARED_MAX // cute_ops.QUERY_LEN,
+                attn.num_kv_heads,
+                cute_ops.attn2_splits(ctx.max_context, 0, attn.num_kv_heads),
+            )
+            workspace = ctx.buffers.get("attn2_workspace")
+            if workspace is None:
+                workspace = torch.zeros(size, dtype=torch.uint8, device=ctx.device)
+                ctx.buffers["attn2_workspace"] = workspace
+            assert workspace.shape == (size,), "attn2_workspace"
+        return cls(
+            attn,
+            OProjection.build(ctx, layer),
+            qkv,
+            out,
+            partial,
+            ctx.max_context,
+            window,
+            num_splits,
+            workspace,
+        )
+
+    def prepare_kv(self) -> None:
+        from . import cute_ops
+
+        kv_cache = self.attn.attn.kv_cache
+        if not isinstance(kv_cache, torch.Tensor) or kv_cache.numel() == 0:
+            return
+        if not cute_ops.kv_cache_layout_ok(kv_cache, self.num_kv_heads):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.layer_name}: KV cache {tuple(kv_cache.shape)} "
+                f"{kv_cache.stride()} {kv_cache.dtype} is not the 16-byte aligned "
+                f"bf16 [pages, {self.num_kv_heads}, 16, 128] layout with dense "
+                "pages the decode kernels read"
+            )
+
+    def front_call(
+        self, step: Step, x: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None:
+        """(kv_cache, slot_mapping) of this layer's QKV front call on ``x``
+        (the step's attention input) into its qkv rows in the current forward
+        context, or None if the kernel does not take the call. Host state
+        only: shapes, dtypes, strides and alignment, the same on every rank
+        (prepare_kv holds every rank's KV cache to the aligned layout)."""
+        from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.attention import (
+            get_attention_context,
+        )
+
+        from . import cute_ops
+
+        _, _, kv_cache, slot_mapping = get_attention_context(self.layer_name)
+        if slot_mapping is None or not cute_ops.supports_call(
+            x,
+            self.weight,
+            step.positions,
+            self.cos_sin_cache,
+            slot_mapping,
+            kv_cache,
+            self.num_kv_heads,
+            self.qkv[: x.shape[0]],
+        ):
+            return None
+        return kv_cache, slot_mapping
+
+    def run(self, step: Step, metadata: Any, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        from . import cute_ops
+
+        b = x.shape[0]
+        # plan() leaves a step the front does not take to the stock forward;
+        # front_call is the launch's check.
+        call = self.front_call(step, x)
+        if call is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"{self.layer_name}: the QKV front cannot take this step"
+            )
+        kv_cache, slot_mapping = call
+        qkv = self.qkv[:b]
+        cute_ops.launch_qkv_front(
+            x,
+            self.weight,
+            step.positions,
+            self.cos_sin_cache,
+            slot_mapping,
+            kv_cache,
+            qkv,
+            self.eps,
+        )
+        q, gate = cute_ops.split_qkv(qkv, self.num_kv_heads)
+        decode = metadata.decode
+        out = self.out[:b]
+        cute_ops.attn2(
+            q,
+            kv_cache,
+            decode.block_tables,
+            decode.seq_lens,
+            gate,
+            out,
+            self.num_kv_heads,
+            max_seq_len=self.max_context,
+            window=self.window,
+            num_splits=self.num_splits,
+            workspace=self.workspace,
+        )
+        return self.oproj.run(out, self.partial[:b])
+
+
+def router_tier(router: nn.Module) -> str | None:
+    """Why the stock GateLinear would not run a vLLM-native kernel for the decode
+    batch (its last tier is F.linear, which follows --linear-backend), or None."""
+    native = (
+        "allow_ll_bf16_gemm",
+        "allow_fp32_router_gemm",
+        "allow_ll_fp32w_gemm",
+        "allow_bf16x3_router_gemm",
+    )
+    if not any(getattr(router, name, False) for name in native):
+        return "a router GEMM outside vLLM's native GateLinear tiers"
+    return None
+
+
+class RoutedMoE:
+    """The MoE: the stock router (GateLinear, asserted on a vLLM-native tier), the
+    routing short tail (``RoutedTopk``; the BF16 edge layers route inside the
+    experts op), the pooler (``ExpertsInput`` or ``ExpertsInputBf16``), the routed
+    experts (``RoutedExpertsOps`` -> ``UnfinalizedExperts``), the tail and the
+    unpooler GEMM, which publishes this rank's column block zero-copy into the
+    next boundary's mailbox.
+
+    With the short tail, the router and the routing run on an aux stream while the
+    pooler runs on the current one, joined before the routed experts. The fork and
+    join are issued directly, not through ``maybe_execute_in_parallel``, which runs
+    both sides in series under this model's breakable CUDA graph capture. The BF16
+    edge layers stay in series: their router logits feed the experts op on the
+    current stream."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        index: int,
+        moe: nn.Module,
+        ops: Any,
+        pooler: Any,
+        pooler_index: int,
+        tail: Any,
+        unpooler: Any,
+        routing: Any,
+        buffers: dict[str, torch.Tensor],
+        aux_stream: torch.cuda.Stream,
+    ):
+        self.index, self.moe, self.ops = index, moe, ops
+        self.pooler, self.pooler_index = pooler, pooler_index
+        self.tail, self.unpooler, self.routing = tail, unpooler, routing
+        self.ids, self.weights = buffers["topk_ids"], buffers["topk_weights"]
+        self.moe_out, self.columns = buffers["moe_out"], buffers["columns"]
+        self.aux_stream = aux_stream
+        self.forked, self.routed = torch.cuda.Event(), torch.cuda.Event()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def unsupported(cls, vllm_config) -> str | None:
+        from . import cute_ops
+
+        types = getattr(vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config, "mlp_layer_types", ())
+        if any(kind != "sparse" for kind in types):
+            return "dense MLP layers"
+        if not cute_ops.routing_available():
+            return cute_ops.unavailable(cute_ops.ROUTING_KERNEL)
+        return None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def build(
+        cls,
+        ctx: BuildContext,
+        layer: nn.Module,
+        *,
+        ops: Any,
+        pooler: Any,
+        pooler_index: int,
+        tail: Any,
+        mailbox: Any,
+    ) -> "RoutedMoE":
+        """``mailbox``: the LamportMailbox of the boundary after this layer."""
+        from vllm.utils.torch_utils import aux_stream
+
+        from ..cutedsl.gemm.unpooler import Unpooler
+        from .cute_ops import MuseRouting
+
+        moe = layer.feed_forward
+        if moe.use_mega_moe or moe.pooler is None or moe.unpooler is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"layer {layer.layer_idx}: unsupported MoE form")
+        reason = router_tier(moe.router)
+        if reason is not None:
+            raise ValueError(f"layer {layer.layer_idx}: {reason}")
+        # The stock layer feeds the router the bf16 MoE input at decode batches
+        # (an fp32 copy only above 32 tokens); the router here reads the same.
+        if any(moe.wants_fp32_router_input(b) for b in BATCHES):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"layer {layer.layer_idx}: an fp32 router input at the decode batch"
+            )
+        routing = None if ops.is_bf16(layer.layer_idx) else MuseRouting(moe.moe_router)
+        buffers = {
+            "topk_ids": _scratch(ctx, "topk_ids", (PREPARED_MAX, TOP_K), torch.int32),
+            "topk_weights": _scratch(
+                ctx, "topk_weights", (PREPARED_MAX, TOP_K), torch.float32
+            ),
+            "moe_out": _scratch(ctx, "moe_out", (PREPARED_MAX, POOLED), torch.bfloat16),
+            "columns": _scratch(
+                ctx, "columns", (PREPARED_MAX, HIDDEN // ctx.tp), torch.bfloat16
+            ),
+        }
+        unpooler = Unpooler.from_moe(moe, ctx.tp, ctx.rank, mailbox=mailbox)
+        tail_layer = tail.bind(moe.post_expert_norm)
+        # The router's kernel for the decode batch, before capture.
+        moe.router(
+            torch.zeros(BATCHES[0], HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=ctx.device)
+        )
+        provider = cls(
+            layer.layer_idx,
+            moe,
+            ops,
+            pooler,
+            pooler_index,
+            tail_layer,
+            unpooler,
+            routing,
+            buffers,
+            aux_stream(),
+        )
+        provider.warm_up()
+        return provider
+
+    def warm_up(self) -> None:
+        """One eager pass, before capture, of the NVFP4 experts path a captured
+        step runs: the plan, the routing, the experts and the tail, so that
+        every first launch and first-use compile happens before capture. The
+        routes spread over all experts, so every EP rank runs its GEMMs.
+        Collective (the tail): every rank warms the same layers in the same
+        order."""
+        if self.routing is None:
+            return
+        b = BATCHES[0]
+        device = self.ids.device
+        inputs = ExpertsInput(
+            torch.zeros((b, POOLED // 2), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device),
+            torch.zeros((b, POOLED // 16), device=device).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        )
+        topk = RoutedTopk(self.ids[:b], self.weights[:b])
+        plan = self.ops.nvfp4_plan(self.index, inputs, topk)
+        # Sigmoid scores of 1 for b * TOP_K experts evenly apart, 0 elsewhere.
+        stride = NUM_EXPERTS // (b * TOP_K)
+        chosen = torch.arange(b * TOP_K, device=device).view(b, TOP_K) * stride
+        logits = torch.full((b, NUM_EXPERTS), -30.0, device=device)
+        logits.scatter_(1, chosen, 30.0)
+        self.routing(
+            logits, topk.ids, topk.weights, None if plan is None else plan.metadata
+        )
+        experts = self.ops.routed_experts(self.index, inputs, topk, plan)
+        self.tail.run(experts, self.moe_out[:b])
+
+    def prepare_kv(self) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    def logits(self, x: torch.Tensor):
+        logits = self.moe.router(x)
+        return logits[0] if isinstance(logits, tuple) else logits
+
+    def run(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        b = x.shape[0]
+        if self.routing is None:
+            logits = self.logits(x)
+            rows = self.pooler.run(self.pooler_index, x)
+            experts = self.ops.routed_experts_bf16(self.index, rows, logits)
+        else:
+            self.forked.record()
+            a, a_sf = self.pooler.run(self.pooler_index, x)
+            inputs = ExpertsInput(a, a_sf)
+            topk = RoutedTopk(self.ids[:b], self.weights[:b])
+            # With a plan the routing also writes the experts' routing metadata,
+            # and the experts op runs without a routing kernel of its own.
+            plan = self.ops.nvfp4_plan(self.index, inputs, topk)
+            with torch.cuda.stream(self.aux_stream):
+                self.forked.wait()
+                self.routing(
+                    self.logits(x),
+                    topk.ids,
+                    topk.weights,
+                    None if plan is None else plan.metadata,
+                )
+                self.routed.record()
+            self.routed.wait()
+            experts = self.ops.routed_experts(self.index, inputs, topk, plan)
+        moe_out = self.moe_out[:b]
+        self.tail.run(experts, moe_out)
+        self.unpooler.run(moe_out, self.columns[:b])
